node.statement: By def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, the ambient multiplication m(X,Y)=X bold-dot Y is bilinear. After choosing real bases in the finite-dimensional source and target spaces, each coordinate of m has the form sum_{i,j} c_{kij} x_i y_j, a polynomial; therefore m is C^infinity as a map of the underlying finite-dimensional real vector spaces.
